description: Display a hand-picked set of products as interactive product cards in the chat (search, price-drop and sale results already show cards on their own). Pass `ids` — the product ids from another CheapestInIndia tool's results (each product line shows `id …`) — and the server loads the full, current product data. Pass search_query (the search behind these products) so the cards link to all results on CheapestInIndia. Do not invent products.

ids.description: Product ids to show, in display order

items.description: CheapestInIndia product id (from search_products, get_product or lookup_product_by_url)

products.description: Alternative to ids: products from another tool, passed through unchanged (reloaded by id)

atLowestPrice.description: True when the current price is the lowest ever recorded

id.description: CheapestInIndia product id — pass through unchanged

lowestPrice.description: Lowest price ever recorded by CheapestInIndia, INR

mrp.description: Maximum retail price in INR, when known

priceChange.description: Most recent price change in INR (negative = price dropped, positive = went up)

productPageUrl.description: CheapestInIndia price-history page — use for citations

productUrl.description: Attributed buy link (CheapestInIndia redirect to the retailer)

search_query.description: The search these products came from, e.g. 'philips air fryer' — adds a 'see all results' link

title.description: Short heading for the cards, e.g. 'Two cheapest Philips air fryers'
